variables.name: SUCCESS
variables.comment: * The code is used when the request is success.

variables.name: ERROR_SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED
variables.comment:
* Return this code if the service doesn't be enabled on the phone.
     * As per the requirement the feature can be enabled/disabled by DM.

variables.name: ERROR_SERVICE_NOT_PUBLISHED
variables.comment: * Return this code if the service didn't publish yet.

variables.name: ERROR_SERVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE
variables.comment: * The service is not available, for example it is 1x only

variables.name: SUBSCRIBER_ERROR_CODE_START
variables.comment: *  SUBSCRIBE Error base

variables.name: SUBSCRIBE_TEMPORARY_ERROR
variables.comment:
* Temporary error and need retry later.
     * such as:
     * 503 Service Unavailable
     * Device shall retry with exponential back-off
     *
     * 408 Request Timeout
     * Device shall retry with exponential back-off
     *
     * 423 Interval Too Short. Requested expiry interval too short and server rejects it
     * Device shall re-attempt subscription after changing the expiration interval in
     * the Expires header field to be equal to or greater than the expiration interval
     * within the Min-Expires header field of the 423 response

variables.name: SUBSCRIBE_NOT_REGISTERED
variables.comment:
* receives 403 (reason="User Not Registered").
     * Re-Register to IMS then retry the single resource subscription if capability polling.
     * availability fetch: no retry.

variables.name: SUBSCRIBE_NOT_AUTHORIZED_FOR_PRESENCE
variables.comment:
* Responding for 403 - not authorized (Requestor)
     * No retry.

variables.name: SUBSCRIBE_FORBIDDEN
variables.comment:
* Responding for "403 Forbidden" or "403"
     * Handle it as same as 404 Not found.
     * No retry.

variables.name: SUBSCRIBE_NOT_FOUND
variables.comment:
* Responding for 404 (target number)
     * No retry.

variables.name: SUBSCRIBE_TOO_LARGE
variables.comment:
*  Responding for 413 - Too Large. Top app need shrink the size
     *  of request contact list and resend the request

variables.name: SUBSCRIBE_GENIRIC_FAILURE
variables.comment:
* All subscribe errors not covered by specific errors
     * Other 4xx/5xx/6xx
     *
     * Device shall not retry

variables.name: SUBSCRIBE_INVALID_PARAM
variables.comment: * Invalid parameter - The caller should check the parameter.

variables.name: SUBSCRIBE_FETCH_ERROR
variables.comment: * Fetch error - The RCS statck failed to fetch the presence information.

variables.name: SUBSCRIBE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT
variables.comment: * Request timeout - The RCS statck returns timeout error.

variables.name: SUBSCRIBE_INSUFFICIENT_MEMORY
variables.comment: * Insufficient memory - The RCS statck returns the insufficient memory error.

variables.name: SUBSCRIBE_LOST_NETWORK
variables.comment: * Lost network error - The RCS statck returns the lost network error.

variables.name: SUBSCRIBE_NOT_SUPPORTED
variables.comment: * Not supported error - The RCS statck returns the not supported error.

variables.name: SUBSCRIBE_GENERIC
variables.comment: * Generic error - RCS Presence stack returns generic error

variables.name: SUBSCRIBE_ALREADY_IN_QUEUE
variables.comment: * There is a request for the same number in queue.

variables.name: SUBSCRIBE_TOO_FREQUENTLY
variables.comment: * Request too frequently.

variables.name: SUBSCRIBER_ERROR_CODE_END
variables.comment: *  The last Subscriber error code

variables.name: PUBLISH_GENERIC_FAILURE
variables.comment: * All publish errors not covered by specific errors

variables.name: PUBLISH_NOT_AUTHORIZED_FOR_PRESENCE
variables.comment: * Responding for 403 - not authorized

variables.name: PUBLISH_NOT_PROVISIONED
variables.comment:
* Responding for 404 error code. The subscriber is not provisioned.
     * The Client should not send any EAB traffic after get this error.
